headline_marked: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in [[Chhatra Dal attack at Rajshahi University]]
headline: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in Chhatra Dal attack at Rajshahi University
summary: Attackers used rods, bats, and sharp weapons to target journalists and students following a dispute over a Facebook comment.
details: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Rajshahi University (RU) Chhatra Dal activists on Sunday night. The attackers targeted journalists and general students who were present at the scene.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall. Tensions rose following a dispute over a Facebook post comment, leading Chhatra Dal activists to gather with rods, bats, and sharp weapons.
The injured journalists include representatives from Somakal, The Daily Star, and bdnews24.com. One journalist, Zahidul Islam, reportedly sustained a severe head injury during the assault.

Witnesses stated that the attackers physically assaulted the journalists and threatened to 'bury' them. At least 10 activists, including senior leaders of the university's Chhatra Dal unit, were allegedly involved in the attack.
The injured were first taken to the university medical center and later shifted to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.

The National Citizens Party (NCP) has strongly condemned the attack, calling for the immediate arrest and exemplary punishment of those involved to ensure the safety of journalists and students on campus.
caption:
10 people injured, including 4 journalists, after Chhatra Dal activists launched a violent attack at Rajshahi University.

At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Rajshahi University (RU) Chhatra Dal activists on Sunday night. The attackers targeted journalists and general students who were present at the scene.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall. Tensions rose following a dispute over a Facebook post comment, leading Chhatra Dal activists to gather with rods, bats, and sharp weapons.

The injured journalists include representatives from Somakal, The Daily Star, and bdnews24.com. One journalist, Zahidul Islam, reportedly sustained a severe head injury during the assault.

Witnesses stated that the attackers physically assaulted the journalists and threatened to 'bury' them. At least 10 activists, including senior leaders of the university's Chhatra Dal unit, were allegedly involved in the attack.

The injured were first taken to the university medical center and later shifted to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.

The National Citizens Party (NCP) has strongly condemned the attack, calling for the immediate arrest and exemplary punishment of those involved to ensure the safety of journalists and students on campus.

headline_marked: 10-year journey ends: [[Pritom and Shahtaj announce divorce]]
headline: 10-year journey ends: Pritom and Shahtaj announce divorce
summary: The musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model Shahtaj Monira Hashem have decided to separate after a decade of being together.
details: Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced their decision to end their marriage due to significant differences in mutual understanding.
In separate Facebook posts on Sunday night, both expressed gratitude for the memories and experiences they shared over their ten-year journey together.
Pritom explained that the decision was not sudden but was reached after much thought, discussions, and with the support and consent of their families.
Shahtaj confirmed the separation to Prothom Alo, stating that they have decided to end their marital relationship amicably and with mutual understanding.
The couple first met in 2017 while working on Pritom's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model. Their relationship developed into a romantic one over several years.
They married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family members and close friends.
Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition, asking friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.
While they had been seen together as recently as January this year, sources close to the couple suggest their relationship had been struggling for some time.
caption:
After a decade together, Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira Hashem are parting ways.

Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced their decision to end their marriage due to significant differences in mutual understanding.

In separate Facebook posts on Sunday night, both expressed gratitude for the memories and experiences they shared over their ten-year journey together.

Pritom explained that the decision was not sudden but was reached after much thought, discussions, and with the support and consent of their families.

Shahtaj confirmed the separation to Prothom Alo, stating that they have decided to end their marital relationship amicably and with mutual understanding.

The couple first met in 2017 while working on Pritom's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model. Their relationship developed into a romantic one over several years.

They married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family members and close friends.

Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition, asking friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.

While they had been seen together as recently as January this year, sources close to the couple suggest their relationship had been struggling for some time.
